description: Find related places Google Maps shows for a business, or discover same-category competitors near it.

categoryFilter.description: Keep only places whose category list contains this text (case-insensitive).
categoryFilter.title: Category contains

categoryOverride.description: Use this category for the same-category fallback instead of the source place's own category.
categoryOverride.title: Category override

deduplicate.description: Keep one row per place, using the canonical Place ID, then the feature ID, then name and coordinates.
deduplicate.title: Remove duplicates

includeDetails.description: Look up each returned place's own page for its canonical Place ID, address, website, phone, categories, plus code, photo count, and image. Adds one request per row and slows dense runs.
includeDetails.title: Include details

includeMedia.description: Include the image URL when Google publishes one.
includeMedia.title: Include images

language.description: Google Maps interface language. Affects names, categories, and the fallback category query.
language.title: Language

location.description: City or area appended to every place name (mode=byQuery).
location.title: Location

maxDistanceKm.description: Keep only related places within this straight-line distance from the source. Requires published coordinates.
maxDistanceKm.title: Maximum distance (km)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of similar places to return across all sources.
maxItems.title: Max results

minRating.description: Drop related places rated below this value. Places without a published rating are dropped when this is above zero.
minRating.title: Minimum rating

minReviews.description: Drop related places with fewer than this many reviews.
minReviews.title: Minimum reviews

minSimilar.description: In auto mode, use the same-category fallback when the carousel has fewer usable rows than this number and cannot already fill Max results.
minSimilar.title: Min similar

mode.description: Choose how to enter the source places.
enumTitles: By place URL or Place ID
mode.title: Mode

placeUrls.description: Google Maps place URLs, canonical ChIJ Place IDs, or legacy 0x…:0x… feature IDs. Mixed values are allowed (mode=byPlace).
placeUrls.title: Place URLs or IDs

searchQueries.description: Business, hotel, or landmark names to resolve and analyze (mode=byQuery).
searchQueries.title: Place names

similaritySource.description: Auto uses Google's related carousel and falls back to same-category nearby places when the carousel has fewer than Min similar. Carousel never uses the fallback. Same category skips the carousel.
similaritySource.title: Related places source

sortBy.description: Order of the returned rows. Recommended keeps Google's carousel and search order.
sortBy.title: Sort by

title: Google Maps Similar Places Input
